chats.answer:
For van life, I'd recommend a LiFePO4 solar generator kit with 1–2 kWh of battery storage and 200–400W of solar panels for most people.

The best kit depends on whether you're running just a laptop, lights, and fridge—or also appliances like an induction cooktop, coffee maker, or air conditioner.

My top brands to compare are EcoFlow, BLUETTI, Jackery, and Anker SOLIX.

These are starting points, not guaranteed daily energy budgets. Solar output varies significantly with weather, shade, season, and panel placement.

One important tip: If you're living in your van full-time, I would prioritize fixed rooftop solar panels and alternator charging over portable folding panels alone. Alternator charging can make a major difference on cloudy days.
